cohort: 2042 singleton children with ASD and 40840 matched controls
finding: Preterm birth, small for gestational age, and Cesarean delivery were found to contribute to ASD risk in a U.S. population.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery had an estimated average population attributable fraction (PAF) of 7.9% for the 1994 cohort and 6.7% for the 2000 cohort.
